briefing: 今日导读：Ballistic Ventures筹集4.9亿美元，加强AI驱动的网络安全市场发展；Netflix推出AI Discover功能，提升观影推荐体验；OpenAI ChatGPT搜索量攀升至谷歌20%，显示巨大增长潜力；Binance安全事件揭示AI在招聘环节的风控挑战。
highlights: 今日看点：AI在搜索、网络安全和推荐系统中的应用显著深化。Ballistic Ventures的筹资及Netflix的新功能表明，对AI技术的需求和创新正在加速，市场潜力庞大。同时，OpenAI ChatGPT的搜索使用量迅速上升至谷歌的20%，预示着未来搜索市场的激烈竞争。Binance事件则提醒企业在招聘环节需要更高水平的AI风控能力，显示出AI安全的不容忽视。

events.title: Ballistic Ventures筹集4.9亿美元
events.summary: 专注于网络安全的Ballistic Ventures正在寻求为其新旗舰基金筹集3.6亿美元，并为另一个投资工具筹集1.3亿美元。此次筹资旨在利用人工智能驱动的网络安全市场的快速增长。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
Ballistic Ventures在推动网络安全投资。### 为什么令人兴奋
AI驱动的安全技术需求显著增长，吸引大量资金。### 产品机会
新型AI安全技术产品及服务将涌现。### 格局影响
增强华尔街对AI安全公司的关注度。### 冷静判断
资金到位后，需要数月时间落实具体项目。### 趋势坐标
显示AI安全技术领域的融资热潮。

articles.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
articles.text: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

events.title: OpenAI ChatGPT 搜索量达谷歌 20%
events.summary: OpenAI 宣布，ChatGPT 的搜索查询量已达到谷歌的 20%。OpenAI 消费者产品负责人 Adam Fry 在新闻发布会上表示，搜索是指用户输入查询并进行网页搜索的情况，而非简单的定义或操作说明。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
ChatGPT的搜索应用使用量大幅增加。### 为什么令人兴奋
AI在用户信息查询和搜索领域展现重要潜力。### 产品机会
传统搜索引擎或需加入AI助手功能。### 格局影响
迫使谷歌等现有巨头加快搜索领域的AI升级。### 冷静判断
需更多时间验证能否替代现有搜索引擎。### 趋势坐标
与近年来AI在消费者应用中大展拳脚的趋势一致。

articles.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
articles.text: In many circles, "Ask Chat" has replaced "Google it," and that's reflected in a new announcement from OpenAI: the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of the volume run through Google. Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT, made the announcement at a press event on Monday. He said the company defines a search as any time a user inputs a query that results in a web search, as opposed to tasks like defining a term or a simple how-to explanation. (Fry did not specify the source of the Google search volume number.) Having one-fifth as many searches as Google is still a long way from overtaking it, b … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
articles.text: Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third-party apps. As part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday, Apple announced developers can now integrate Siri AI's new features in "all apps," allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user's personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on-screen awareness to complete requests. The update, which is rolling out as part of a Developer Preview, also adds a new "app skills" feature that third-party developers can create to combine several tasks into a single action. In Apple's developer documentation , the company says users won't have to mention an app's name in their … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Apple’s latest watchOS beta includes its new always-on Audio Intelligence features
articles.text: Starting today, Siri can tune into the Apple Watch's mic with Audio Intelligence features that are available in the new watchOS 27.3 developer beta rolling out now. The two new additions are Siri Recap, which uses "ambient listening" to generate summaries of your conversation, and Live Rewind, which generates text transcripts of the last 15 seconds of audio your watch's mic detected.
